Equations of motion of the semi-axes with gravitational potential integrals
Substitution of sum/difference variables for rotation components
Equilibrium conditions expressed through tau, rho with elliptic integrals
Solving linear system for tau and rho
Case distinction on relative size of 2c and a±b
